messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: sara.connors@megaapps.com
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-quarter leadership alignment: OKR triage and QBR playbook inputs

Team —

As we cross the midpoint of the quarter I want a succinct view of the top tradeoffs we need to take for OKR delivery and input into the QBR playbook (attached). We have a small window to re-scope KRs that are at risk and to surface dependency escalations that require cross-functional help.

Please respond by EOD Monday with:
- a one-line status for each KR you own (On track / At risk / Re-scope suggested)
- up to two dependency asks (who we need, what we need, ETA impact)
- one proposed change if you think we should re-scope (prefer short, actionable phrasing)

Quick context:
- The QBR doc (link and attached PDF) will be shared with execs next week; I want to avoid surprises in the numbers and narrative.
- Customer highlight: MegaApps (cc'd) is interested in our Dedicated routing SLA updates — this factors into the QBR story.

Attachments: QBR-playbook-v0.3.pdf, model-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — KD

--
Kimberly Park
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership alignment: OKR triage and QBR playbook inputs

Kimberly —

Quick status on my KRs (upper-priority ones only):
- KR: Reduce hosted API 95th latency by 20% — At risk. We have a working kernel patch that shows ~12% improvement in perf lab, but it regresses memory on some sequence lengths. Need infra validation + SRE canary to proceed.
  - Dependency ask: SRE time for a two-day canary + infra approval for instance type change (need 1 Nvidia A10 pool slot). ETA impact if approved: 3 weeks to roll canary + safety window.
- KR: Expand model catalog with 3 new Redwood-verified models — On track. Two models validated; third delayed pending legal review of license text.
  - Dependency ask: Legal to prioritize model licensing review (2 business days).

Proposed re-scope: For the latency KR, shift from a hard 20% to a pragmatic 12–15% target for this quarter and push the remaining delta to next quarter. Rationale: keeps the win in the QBR narrative and avoids a risky cross-stack rollout that could affect availability.

Notes: I attached the model-onboarding checklist with remaining items. Happy to present the tradeoff in the leadership slot on Tuesday.

Laura
Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mid-quarter leadership alignment: OKR triage and QBR playbook inputs

Thanks Laura & team —

Quick replies and a recommendation from infra/serving side:
- Latency KR: I agree with Laura's conservative re-scope to 12–15% this quarter. The kernel patch needs a short ramp in traffic patterns we haven't exercised (long-prefill + interactive chat). My ask from Product: sign-off to run the canary on non-production traffic for 72 hours and to allow swapping to a slightly higher-memory instance class if the regression on p99 shows up. SRE estimate: 16 hours prep + 48–72 hours monitoring. Impact to schedule: if approved this week, we can have a canary complete by Aug 6 and production push by Aug 13.
- Model catalog KR: we'll support fast-tracking the third model onboarding if Legal can clear it by Wednesday (per Laura). We can parallelize some validation steps to shave ~4 days.

Tradeoff recommendation for QBR narrative: present the latency work as "material progress with staged rollout; re-baselined target for reliability" — this tells the story of measured risk management rather than an outright missed target.

Operational asks (action items):
1) Kimberly: approve canary plan and instance class flexibility (I can attach a short runbook).
2) Laura: confirm which exact model repo/legal reference to escalate.
3) Jordan: can you coordinate with SRE on the A10 pool request?

Appreciate the quick, focused updates. Decision summary and next steps for the leadership thread / QBR narrative: 

1) Latency KR (95th): Approve re-scope to 12–15% for Q3 narrative. Action: Vivek — proceed with the canary plan. Kimberly approves instance-class flexibility for the canary stage only. Jordan — coordinate SRE / A10 booking. Target: canary start by 7/26, complete by 8/6, production push (if green) by 8/13.

2) Model catalog: Laura to escalate legal now; Vivek and Platform to parallelize validation where safe. If Legal signs off by 7/15 we will keep this KR marked as "On track" in the QBR.

3) QBR playbook: I'm updating the executive slide bundle with the re-baselined latency target and the canary risk mitigation steps. Sara (MegaApps) — we'll call out an upcoming note about routing SLA progress; expect a short note from Jordan on timeline.

4) Dependencies and asks: Laura — attach any runbook or failure-mode bullets to the shared QBR doc. Vivek — please add the canary runbook and monitoring checklist. Jordan — confirm A10 pool slot and SRE lead by EOD Monday.

I'll consolidate these into the QBR playbook and send the exec version Tuesday morning. Thanks for keeping this crisp.

--
Kimberly Park
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
